# TA-127: vulnerability IDs pip-audit reports against backend/requirements.txt
# that are deliberately accepted rather than fixed. See SECURITY.md for the
# reasoning and severity behind each group. One ID per line; blank lines and
# lines starting with # are ignored by the dependency-scan job's parsing.
#
# Adding an ID here without a corresponding SECURITY.md entry defeats the
# point of the scanner -- don't.

# ecdsa (transitive, via python-jose) -- Minerva timing attack, no fix
# upstream, unreachable (app is HS256-only, never does ECDSA ops)
PYSEC-2026-1325

# pyasn1 (transitive, via python-jose/rsa) -- DoS via deeply nested ASN.1
# recursion. Unreachable for the same reason as ecdsa above, and blocked
# from upgrading anyway: python-jose 3.4.0 pins pyasn1<0.5.0, one full
# major version behind the 0.6.3 fix.
PYSEC-2026-2263
PYSEC-2026-3455
PYSEC-2026-3456
PYSEC-2026-3457

# pytest -- dev/CI tool only, never processes attacker-supplied input.
# Fix is a major-version (9.x) bump with real plugin-compatibility risk
# for no security benefit.
PYSEC-2026-1845

# starlette (transitive, via fastapi) -- the most severe finding
# (PYSEC-2026-1943, CVSS 8.7, unbounded multipart buffering) is FIXED as
# part of this ticket. These remain, all needing a starlette version
# fastapi's current pin (<0.42.0) doesn't allow yet -- tracked as a
# follow-up ticket alongside the pypdf major-version bump below.
# PYSEC-2026-1942 is the one to prioritize in that follow-up: CVSS 7.5,
# reachable via this app's own /documents/{id}/file download endpoint
# (uses FileResponse, which is what the vulnerable Range-header parsing
# is in).
PYSEC-2026-161
PYSEC-2026-1941
PYSEC-2026-1942
PYSEC-2026-2280
PYSEC-2026-2281
PYSEC-2026-248
PYSEC-2026-249

# pypdf -- DoS-class only (infinite loops / memory exhaustion on a
# crafted PDF; nothing RCE or info-disclosure found across everything
# sampled during triage), but this app parses arbitrary user-uploaded
# PDFs, so it's real attack surface, not a low priority. Fix is a
# 5.x -> 6.x major-version bump needing a dedicated regression pass
# against every PdfReader/PdfWriter call site -- tracked as a follow-up
# ticket, not folded into this one.
CVE-2026-57204
